name: QR Code
description: A corner widget that opens the chosen QR code full screen on tap: a URL, plain text or this kiosk's Wi-Fi credentials. The same QR opens from a gesture with the Show QR code action.
author: shin-01

settings.title: Show corner widget
settings.description: Keep the tappable widget in a display corner.

settings.title: Widget title
settings.description: The label on the corner widget and the heading of the QR card.

settings.title: Widget icon
settings.description: The icon on the corner widget.

settings.title: QR size
settings.description: The size of the QR code in the full screen card.

settings.title: QR content type
settings.description: What the QR code encodes. Wi-Fi shares this kiosk's network credentials, URL opens a link, Text encodes anything else.

settings.title: Network name (SSID)
settings.description: The Wi-Fi network the QR code joins.

settings.title: Password
settings.description: The Wi-Fi password, masked in the Plugin Manager and Remote Admin.

settings.title: URL
settings.description: The link the QR code opens, such as https://www.kiosksatellite.com/

settings.title: Text
settings.description: Any text the QR code carries.
